subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should explicit `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` become strict and refuse startup when no usable Tailnet address exists, leaving availability fallback only to `auto`?
rationale: Strict behavior best matches the documented mode, but it can stop gateways that currently remain locally available during transient Tailscale failures, so the upgrade-impact choice requires gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Make Tailnet strict
options.body: Fail explicit Tailnet startup with an actionable diagnostic and retain fallback behavior only for `auto`.

options.title: Keep degraded startup
options.body: Continue on loopback but add a prominent startup and status warning that Tailnet reachability was not established.

recommendation.title: Make Tailnet strict
recommendation.body: Fail explicit Tailnet startup with an actionable diagnostic and retain fallback behavior only for `auto`.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for gateway startup and network-fallback policy based on project ownership and recent gateway hardening history.
